title: CORS
shortDescription: Setting, deleting, and viewing the configuration of the cross-origin request (CORS) mechanism in buckets
metaDescription: All available methods for working with the cross-origin request (CORS) mechanism configuration in VK Object Storage buckets: get the current configuration (GetBucketCORS), set the configuration (PutBucketCORS), delete the configuration (DeleteBucketCORS)
